Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and any further Fed commentary. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs for signs of further decay.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management, particularly on your leveraged and deeply negative positions.
plays: Review SOXL (-55.97%) and SPAL (-39.94%) immediately. Consider cutting losses or significantly reducing exposure on these highly leveraged, decaying positions.
Trim SMH (-12.87%) and QQQI (-3.37%) as flagged by your scanner to reduce overall portfolio risk.
